plan.notes: Official CSUDH 2025-2026 Academic Catalog, Sociology B.A. program page, 4-Year Roadmap (Plan of Study Grid). Semester sums reconcile exactly with printed Hours; total 120. 'SOC 101 or SOC 102' modeled as a choice slot with code = first-listed option per convention. The six 'Major Elective' slots are the catalog's six additional upper-division sociology courses selected with an advisor; the department recommends concentrating them in one basic area of study (Applied Research, Community Studies, Criminology and Justice Studies, Helping Professions, Social Change in Global Contexts, or Social Inequalities). SOC 309 satisfies the GWAR writing requirement per source. Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented; sequencing follows the official roadmap order.
